column2: State your business first, citizen. Then hear this. A giant crab, Old Salty, lives in the shallows, forty-five paces east-south-east of this bench. Giant mudcrabs sit on the shore sixty paces east-north-east. Keep clear of both.

Soulrest? Attend, citizen. Go north-east, about two hundred and sixty paces, until Lilmoth is on your right. Then east two hundred paces, until the burnt-out house is on your left. Then south-east, about a hundred and thirty paces, to Lilmoth Dock. From there, ask again. Soulrest lies further east.
You again, my friend. Good. The watch is quiet. Stand easy and I will tell you if that changes.
Halt, citizen. State your business. Keep your hands clear of your weapon.
I am Hard-Scale. I am a soldier in the pay of the Lilmoth council. I guard the south side of Hereguard, where the crop is grown. Nothing happens here while I stand watch.
Rakhee-Tul stands five paces north of this bench. He holds the easier post. He sleeps on it. Report to him if you must, citizen. Do not expect much.
